title: Galderma to buy ZO Skin Health for $1.5 billion to strengthen dermatology portfolio
summary: Galderma has signed an agreement to buy physician-dispensed brand ZO Skin Health to expand its dermatological ​skin care offering in ‘the fast-growing medical-grade skin care segment’. The deal could close as early as Q4 2026

extraction.key_fact: 갈더마가 메디컬 등급 피부과 스킨케어 포트폴리오를 강화하기 위해 제오 스킨 헬스를 인수하는 계약을 체결했다.
